corrections: Stanford page14 mislabels domination and neutral-element laws; classifications follow definitions.
CMU page6 zero-x branch repeats positive-x indices; four-way reconstruction retains the correct restrictions.
CMU unary derivative-one statement requires nonconstant dependence; constants have derivative zero.
CMU opposite polarities in a cover do not prove semantic binateness; the example absorbs to y OR not-z.
CMU simplified product-difference rules require the multiplied factor to be independent of the differentiated input; derive from cofactors.
Berkeley expression/circuit representability is not uniqueness of circuit topology, and fewer literals do not guarantee physical speed.
MIT hazard/cost claims need the stated gate and transition models; no unrestricted hardware guarantee.
